content: Colors are everywhere. Children can learn colors by looking at toys, clothes, and nature around them.
Shapes help children understand objects. A ball is a circle, a box is a square, and a slice of pizza looks like a triangle.
Eating fruits and vegetables helps children grow strong and healthy. Apples, bananas, and carrots give energy.
Saying please, thank you, and sorry shows good manners. Being kind to friends and family makes everyone happy.
Animals make fun sounds. A dog says woof, a cat says meow, and a cow says moo. Children can learn their names too.
Learning body parts like eyes, ears, hands, and feet helps children know themselves and describe the world.
Daily routines like brushing teeth, washing hands, and bedtime make children healthy and organized.
Weather changes every day. Children can learn about sun, rain, clouds, and snow through observation.
Family and friends are important. Children learn to share, care, and spend time with loved ones.
Safety at home is important. Children should learn not to touch sharp objects, hot stoves, or run indoors.
